content: Kiara Sen calls Sunita Agarwal from Protect All Agency to discuss her expired health policy (H-34219), which lapsed on 15/09/2026. Kiara expresses disappointment as she needed it for upcoming eye surgery. Sunita guides her through the renewal process, collects necessary personal and medical details, and agrees to email a renewal quote for electronic signature.

action_items: Sunita to send a renewal quote via email
Kiara to review and sign the renewal quote electronically
